digest_semantics: SHA-256 over exact canonical resource bytes; this is resource integrity only and not a semantic graph digest.

terminal_external_gate_topology.sink_rule: Dependencies among nodes in one manual-gate or corrective-join requires set are valid. For every dependency edge from prerequisite P to successor S, if P belongs to one or more external joins then S must belong to every one of those joins. An edge that leaves any containing external join is rejected at that exact depends_on path.
terminal_external_gate_topology.issue_path: The exact $.nodes[i].depends_on[j] edge that leaves an external-gate prerequisite.
terminal_external_gate_topology.complexity: Validation indexes every external-gate prerequisite to all of its requires memberships and scans each declared dependency edge once, with O(N + E + R) time plus bounded membership checks and deterministic issues.
terminal_external_gate_topology.generation_boundary: Work governed by the external decision is expressed only in a later Graph generation supplied and authorized by the host after the gate decision. This contract does not create that generation, infer lineage, add a join-to-node edge, or dynamically rewrite the Graph.
terminal_external_gate_topology.independent_work: Nodes inside one external join may retain their declared internal dependency order. Nodes outside a containing external join cannot succeed one of its prerequisites in the same generation. Nodes with no such unsafe edge may remain in the same generation and continue according to their own dependencies and resources.
terminal_external_gate_topology.non_goals: The rule introduces no WAITING_GATE or SKIPPED status, scheduler, hidden resolver edge, runtime mutation, gate decision, or authority grant. Automatic joins do not make their prerequisites dependency sinks.

reachability_truth.root_definition: Graph Contract v1 has no entry or target field. A root is any declared node whose depends_on array is empty.
reachability_truth.dag_theorem: In every finite reference-complete acyclic dependency graph, following predecessor edges from any node terminates at at least one root; therefore every valid node is reachable from a root by definition.
reachability_truth.failure_expression: A purported static unreachable condition is expressed honestly by existing missing-dependency, dependency-cycle, or unsafe external-gate topology issues.
reachability_truth.non_goal: Graph Contract v1 introduces no fabricated UNREACHABLE node status, disposition, or validation issue.

compatibility: Language-neutral Graph Contract v1 and Node Result v1 data boundaries with machine-enforced terminal topology for manual-gate and corrective-join prerequisites. Existing valid Graph semantic projection and digest are unchanged. Schema presence does not activate Graph execution, runtime state, scheduling, node execution, gates, authority, or later-generation creation. Light remains graph-artifact optional.

packaged_mirror.expectation: All resources are byte-identical mirrors of canonical resources in docs/contracts/graph/v1.
